apply_extrinsic_transform: apply extrinsic camera rotation and translation to 3D joint coordinates using calibration data
project_2d_joints: project 3D joints to 2D image coordinates with optional lens distortion correction and image bounds check
export_panoptic_to_spin: export processed Panoptic DB haggling sequences to SPIN format with body and hand keypoints saved as NPZ
review_applyExtrinsic: review the applyExtrinsic function that transforms 3D joints using camera rotation matrix and translation vector
refactor_project2D: refactor the project2D function to support configurable distortion coefficient indices for different camera models
